title: New-Age-Diskurs in der polnischen Literaturwissenschaft, Literaturkritik und Lyrik der 70er und 80er Jahre
summary: In the present work, an individualistic and mystical oriented flow of Polish literary criticism, literary criticism and poetry of the late 70s and 80s, characterized by the idea of ​​a "new privacy", a social and individual transformation, is investigated and used in a comprehensive context of the New Age discourse manifested in America and Europe since the late 1970s in various cultural areas.
